mathematics.assertion_tested: The complete fixed-metric lapse first variation includes measure, acceleration and weighted-heat-generator variations, with the latter matching a Duhamel weighted-adjoint formula.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Real smooth continuum derivation recorded separately; deterministic IEEE binary64 finite weighted-graph surrogate using NumPy and SciPy
mathematics.conventions: Periodic 12-node cycle, D forward oriented edge derivative, P endpoint mean, M=dx diag(exp(logN)), W=dx diag(exp(P logN)), L=-M^-1 D^T W D; U fixed under lapse variation.
inputs: Deterministic smooth lapse, field and lapse perturbation on a cycle
non_claims: Finite graph does not prove a continuum convergence theorem
No full metric or clock variation
No physical causal response or degrees-of-freedom count
